(2) Perfected security interest: no UCC-1 financing statement of record — not allowed_secured. (3) Employee wages: wages earned 2025-09-02 through 2025-11-30 fall within the 180-day pre-petition window (on/after 2025-07-24), but the asserted amount of $22,400.00 exceeds the $15,150.00 priority cap, so the claim does not take priority treatment. (4) Everything else: falls to allowed_general_unsecured. The creditor's self-characterization as "priority" is not evidence of treatment per the memo.
